title: Walmart's Flipkart is quietly building a food delivery challenger in India | TechCrunch
summary: Flipkart is doing the reverse, using its established e-commerce business and growing quick-commerce operations as a springboard into food delivery. “Flipkart’s quick commerce benefit will get passed on to food delivery, so it will be leaner, more efficient,” Daryani told TechCrunch.
